player_prompt.intro:
Karibu katika Ziwa Lililofungwa!

Wewe unawakilishwa na 'P' kwenye gridi.
Miwani ya Gridi:
  ' ' = Uso uliofunika na barafu (salama kuendesha)
  'H' = Shimo (anguka ndani na upotee!)
  'G' = Mwisho (fikia hii ili ushinde!)
  'P' = Nafasi yako ya sasa

Mabano yanayopatikana: juu, chini, kushoto, kulia (au w, a, s, d)
Andika hatua yako kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] au [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lengo: Abiri kutoka kuanzia (juu-kushoto) hadi mwisho (chini-kulia) bila kuanguka kwenye mashimo yoyote!

invalid_move.unknown_action: Unknown action '{action}'. Use up, down, left, right, or w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Umeanguka kwenye shimo! Mchezo umemaliza. Umeanza {pct}% ya safari hadi mwisho.
outcome.turn_limit: You reached the turn limit! Game over. You completed {pct}% of the journey to the goal.
